---
title: "Retained 16S paired ordination display"
format: html
---

Uses archived coordinates without recalculating distances or statistics.

```{r}
library(data.table);library(ggplot2);library(patchwork)
out<-commandArgs(TRUE)[1];stopifnot(!dir.exists(out));dir.create(out,recursive=TRUE)
path<-"/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569/derived/16s_analysis/09_return_package/16s_beta_ordination_coordinates.tsv"
d<-fread(path);stopifnot(nrow(d)==24,uniqueN(d$sample_title)==12)
d[,condition:=factor(condition,levels=c("control","treatment"),labels=c("Control","Treatment"))]
d[,phase:=factor(phase,levels=c("initial","backflush"),labels=c("Initial","Backflush"))]
panel<-function(metric_name,title){
 x<-d[metric==metric_name]
 ggplot(x,aes(axis1,axis2,colour=condition,shape=phase))+
 geom_point(size=2.3)+geom_text(aes(label=cycle),nudge_y=diff(range(x$axis2))*.045,size=2.8,show.legend=FALSE)+
 scale_colour_manual(values=c(Control="#8FCB8A",Treatment="#7E57C2"))+
 scale_shape_manual(values=c(Initial=16,Backflush=17))+
 scale_y_continuous(expand=expansion(mult=.12))+
 labs(x=sprintf("Axis 1 (%.1f%%)",x$axis1_percent_variance[1]),y=sprintf("Axis 2 (%.1f%%)",x$axis2_percent_variance[1]),colour=NULL,shape=NULL)+
 theme_classic(base_size=9)+theme(plot.title=element_text(size=10),legend.position="bottom",plot.margin=margin(8,8,8,8))
}
p<-(panel("bray_curtis","Bray-Curtis")+panel("aitchison","Aitchison"))+plot_layout(guides="collect")+plot_annotation(tag_levels="A") & theme(legend.position="bottom")
ggsave(file.path(out,"paired-ordinations.pdf"),p,width=7.25,height=3.6,device=pdf,useDingbats=FALSE)
fwrite(d,file.path(out,"plotted_coordinates.tsv"),sep="\t")
writeLines(digest::digest(file=path,algo="sha256"),file.path(out,"source_sha256.txt"))
```
